defect:A4-counter-valve-severity-mismatc.title: The blocker counter and its release valve disagree about severity, and a run cannot converge because of it
defect:A4-counter-valve-severity-mismatc.what: `unverified_critical_count()` counts findings with **no severity test at all** — it skips non-UNCONFIRMED, already-escalated and exhausted entries, then counts whatever is left. But the only thing that can RELEASE an entry from that count, the `exhausted` valve, requires severity of 0.7 or above. So a sub-critical finding can ENTER the tally of findings that block convergence, and has no way out of it.
defect:A4-counter-valve-severity-mismatc.why: It is live and it blocked a real run. Finding C0042 in `study_run1b_2026-10-03` sits at severity 0.6 with a zero-character falsifier, emitted in round 2 and never given one. Leave-one-out on the live registry: removing it drops the blocker count from 1 to 0. It blocks the zero-critical streak for every remaining round, so **that run could not converge**. You issued `d` on 2026-10-03 and nothing has changed since, so the run is still obstructed.
options: **Make the counter and the valve share ONE severity predicate** — the symmetric fix, and the one the defect record itself asks for. A finding either enters the blocker tally and can be released from it, or it does neither.

**Restore the severity gate to the counter**, so only criticals ever enter it. Measured consequence: that takes the blocker tally from 3 to 0 on this run's pre-sweep registry, after which the gate blocks on `contested=2` and the zero-critical streak instead.
**Lower the valve's severity requirement** to match the counter, which releases sub-criticals but weakens what `exhausted` means.
defect:A4-counter-valve-severity-mismatc.evidence_line: The counter's own docstring claims it counts `severity >= CRITICAL_SEVERITY_THRESHOLD`, which its body does not do — stale since the gate was removed on 2026-09-06. A second defect found alongside: `exhausted_round_threshold` defaulted to 8 while the maximum reachable age in an 8-round run is 7, so the valve could not fire in ANY 8-round run; z3 returns unsat, NumPy's enumeration of all 36 legal pairs gives max age 7, SymPy gives the general condition T <= R-1. That half is fixed — the Exp 56 configs now set 6.

defect:integrity-gate-interpreter-carve-.title: The integrity gate refuses a correct falsifier, and must refuse it by construction
defect:integrity-gate-interpreter-carve-.what: The sandbox integrity gate allows the harness's own Python 3.13 directories. A falsifier that spawns a second interpreter gets macOS's own Python 3.9 at `/usr/bin/python3`, whose standard library sits under `/Library` and whose user-site sits under `~` — both inside the denied regions. Its ordinary import reads are recorded as denials, and **any** denial becomes an INTEGRITY_VIOLATION.
defect:integrity-gate-interpreter-carve-.why: It is structural, not incidental. Finding C0050's falsifier spawns `/usr/bin/python3` precisely BECAUSE the defect it demonstrates is that the target prescribes a bare unpinned `python3`. Any falsifier for that defect class must do the same thing, so the gate is guaranteed to refuse the correct falsifier. C0050 is severity 0.7 — a critical — and was recorded as untested and pushed to a human. Proved by counterfactual: with the 3.9 roots allowed, the identical falsifier returns CONFIRMED instead of INTEGRITY_VIOLATION.
options: **Run it and flag the denials as a reporting metric** rather than refusing. This is the option the defect record leans toward, and it has a measured side effect worth knowing: the finding stops being `contested`, which removes a second obstruction to convergence on its own.
**Keep refusing and widen the carve-out** to include system interpreters. This preserves the refusal but means `contested` must be named explicitly in the fix, or the convergence bug survives it.
**Keep refusing with no change**, accepting that this defect class can never be falsified inside the harness.
defect:integrity-gate-interpreter-carve-.evidence_line: The refuse-rather-than-flag behaviour entered on 2026-08-15 in a milestone merge citing NO founder ruling, and you confirmed on 2026-10-03 that you were never consulted. Cost on this run: 34 matched-read lines and 6 banners over-reported for one finding.
